OUR WORK · AGTECH · AI

AI that spots crop disease under the microscope.

BioScout puts disease-detection devices on farms right around Australia. Each one catches spores floating in the air and photographs them under a built-in microscope. Then AI does the looking, so farmers get an early heads-up.

Before Sunday Solutions, one of our team spent three years as a software engineer at BioScout, building the software that turns those AI results into alerts and charts farmers actually use.

  • 500+ devices across Australia
  • AI checks every image
  • Early warnings for farmers
See what the AI sees ↓

From a puff of air to a heads-up for the farmer.

  1. 01

    Catch

    The device draws in air. Spores, pollen and dust stick to a strip of tape.

  2. 02

    Snap

    A built-in microscope photographs the tape up close.

  3. 03

    Spot

    AI checks every photo and picks the disease spores out from the pollen and dust.

  4. 04

    Warn

    The counts become charts and alerts that farmers and agronomists can act on.

WHERE WE CAME IN

BioScout built the devices and the AI. We helped build what farmers see.

One of a small team of engineers working on the customer dashboard and the systems behind it, for three years. Here's some of it, in plain English.

  • Millions of AI results, moved safelyLed the move of millions of AI spore detections into a new, better system. Every row was checked before switching over, and nothing had to be rolled back.
  • Charts a farmer can readBuilt the charts for spore counts, infection risk and weather, including 7-day forecasts. They work with a mouse on a desktop or a thumb out in the paddock.
  • Alerts at a glanceShipped disease alerts that colour-code the risk, so the worst news is the easiest to spot.
  • Faster screensMade a key screen 3 to 4 times faster, even when it was pulling from 15 million rows of data.

Big-league experience. Odd-job prices.
